items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: Steve Wright had the band. ... we was out in Staten Island, three or four of us, a gig for that night.

ctx.x: Herman, of all these tunes that you wrote, why was 'Yacht Club Swing the one that got more attention than any of the rest?
Well, as I told you, Fats was in Europe when it happened, and we was out in Staten Island, three or four of us, a gig for that night. I will never forget it. Steve Wright had the band.
He had taken over Fats's band?
